0.original: Much like her brother, Alisaie also loves it when a plan comes together.

24.original: Follow Alisaie to the Isle of Zekki.

25.original: Seek out and slay Red Kojin near the Dive.

26.original: Seek out and slay Red Kojin elsewhere on the Isle of Zekki.

48.original: This has to work. I know it! I just hope Gosetsu and the others are all right...

49.original: Beneath the waters to the west of Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato lies a cave that will lead you to the Isle of Zekki. May the kami watch over and keep you.

50.original: I don't know about you two, but I'm as ready as I'll ever be.

52.original: Right. Right. Naught left to say, then...

56.original: R-Right! Let's go and find that cave!

57.original: Me? Nervous? Come now. I mean, it's not as though I haven't risked my life in ridiculous ways before.

58.original: Well, maybe I am a little bit... Hm. Strangest thing, that. Completely out of character, even. Anyway, let's go!

59.original: I hope you didn't waste too much energy swimming here. Once the fighting starts, I doubt we'll have a moment to rest.

60.original: Assuming this is the right cave, it should lead us straight into the heart of the Isle of Zekki...

61.original: Have you got a plan for once we get to the isle?

62.original: Hmm... How about two of us get the guards' attention while the third heads straight for the vault?

63.original: Afterwards, the other two join them there, and together we make a stand. With our numbers, it's not feasible to do anything more complicated, I think.

64.original: Fine by me. I like simple plans. I'll be one of the decoys, then.

65.original: You read my mind. I also had a mind to ask <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> to be one, given <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> peerless martial prowess.

66.original: Then it's settled. You two will make your way through the stronghold, creating as much chaos as possible. You know, have some fun.

67.original: Meanwhile, I will attempt to locate the vault and gain entry with the ceremonial knife. When I am inside, I will contact you via linkpearl.

68.original: Right! Come on, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! We've got work to do!

73.original: You're a sight for sore eyes! I hope Alisaie's all right too...

74.original: (-Alisaie-)<hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, Lyse, can you hear me? I've found the vault!

75.original: (-Alisaie-)Head northwest. There's a passage leading deeper within. Hurry!

76.original: Come on, you Red bastards! Is that the best you can do!?

77.original: There you are! The entrance is straight ahead.

78.original: Good timing, I might add. It sounds like the whole garrison is headed straight for us...

79.original: We should, um...we should definitely talk strategy before we do anything else!

80.original: <pant> <pant> That...that was not part of the plan! A Kojin primal was most definitely not part of the plan!

81.original: ...Though I am sure there is a perfectly logical explanation involving the aether stored in the treasures and the religious fervor with which the Kojin guard them. Or something. <sigh> A pity Alphinaud isn't here to provide it.

82.original: And just when I thought our fortunes had changed. I swear, if Soroban and his people knew this might happen...

83.original: ...No, somehow I doubt that. Even the Red seemed surprised by what happened.

84.original: All rises and falls at the whim of capricious fortune, does it? Then the same goes for him. We have to defeat that primal!
